name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: House committee urges DOJ to charge former Trump prosecutor Jack Smith
changes.summary: The GOP chair of the House Judiciary Committee encouraged the DOJ to look into criminally charging Jack Smith, alleging the former special counsel who brought charges against President Trump lied to Congress.

changes.title: Houthis claim strikes on two Saudi tankers as US attacks on Iran widen

changes.title: Trump’s 50% Tariffs on Canada: What to Know, and What’s Next
changes.summary: The president said punishing 50 percent tariffs would begin by Aug. 19, a significant escalation of the trade war between Canada and the U.S. that he started over a year ago.

changes.title: Sen. Bennet rails against trade chief for Trump policy's impact on farmers
changes.summary: Sen. Michael Bennet, a Democrat from Washington, challenged some of U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer's assertions about the successes of President Trump's trade policies and their impact on farmers.

changes.title: Rubio and Chinese Diplomat Make Plans for Trump and Xi’s Washington Summit
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio spent much of a meeting with China’s foreign minister discussing the summit, but did not bring up President Trump’s claims of election interference by China.

changes.title: Latest on U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal, Trump threats against Iranian infrastructure
changes.summary: CBS News National security analyst Aaron MacLean breaks down President Trump's threats against Iranian infrastructure and the United States' new nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Trump speaks at Georgia high school after attending dignified transfer
changes.summary: President Trump spoke at a high school in Marietta, Georgia, on Wednesday, after attending a dignified transfer for four U.S. troops killed in the Middle East. CBS News congressional reporter Taurean Small has the latest.

changes.title: Trump says U.S. will destroy a bridge or power plant for each Iranian attack in the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: President Donald Trump's latest threat to target civilian infrastructure came as the unpopular war spirals with no clear off-ramp, threatening further worldwide economic disruption and sending fuel prices up ahead of midterm U.S. elections this fall.

changes.title: Laredo’s Future Rides on Trump’s Next Trade Move
changes.summary: The economy of Laredo, Texas, has boomed under the president’s global tariffs. Now, his demands may threaten its success.

changes.title: Speaking for Fallen Soldiers, Trump Says They Supported the Iran War
changes.summary: President Trump attended a dignified transfer for the soldiers as Americans were growing increasingly critical of the war.
